conventions.tree: Cash-dividend non-recombining CRR; recombination only within intervals
conventions.exercise_timing: Compare before-dividend exercise with ex-dividend continuation; continuation also allows immediate post-dividend exercise
conventions.low_price_policy: Stock equity is absorbing at zero and cash dividends cannot exceed it; only negligible-probability extreme nodes affected here
conventions.premiums: Use American minus European on the same lattice to remove GBSM-vs-tree discretization error
conventions.greeks: Central finite differences on a FIXED N grid; extra 1e-4 and 1e-5 bumps are diagnostic
conventions.dividend_sensitivity: Central amount differences, primary bump0.001; bump0.01 exported as robustness check

conventions.moments: sample variance; population standardized skewness/excess kurtosis
conventions.historical_tail: course floor/ceil order average and threshold-mean ES
conventions.model_limit: Unbounded Normal/t arithmetic returns can theoretically be <=-100%; any observed such path raises rather than silently truncating

q4.annualization: Sharpe uses sqrt(12); plots and VaR/ES use monthly returns
q4.historical_risk_convention: course order-statistic average and threshold-tail mean; fractional-tail sensitivity separately reported

q5.annualization: 255 times daily arithmetic expected returns; Sharpe multiplied by sqrt(255); geometric sample return reported separately
q5.unit_conversion: Fund returns already decimals; every factor and RF column divided by 100 exactly once
q5.regression_covariance: Classical OLS homoskedastic standard errors, intercept plus all specified factor slopes; Gaussian AICc k includes sigma
q5.stress_convention: Incremental momentum factor shock only: -$10m * beta_Mom * worst_Mom; other factor shocks are zero and alpha/RF drift excluded
